summary.text: Patrick Windhorst is a Republican Illinois state representative who has served in the House since 2019, currently representing District 117, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney, he lives in Metropolis, Illinois.

paragraphs.text: Patrick Windhorst graduated from Massac County High School and earned an A.A. from Shawnee Community College in 1995, a B.S. in journalism from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign in 1997, and a J.D. from Southern Illinois University at Carbondale in 2000.
His career experience includes working as an attorney with the Massac County State's Attorney's Office and with Denton & Keuler.
Windhorst's tenure in the Illinois House began in 2019, and Ballotpedia lists him as winning general elections for District 118 in 2018 and 2020 and for District 117 in 2022 and 2024.
He assumed office for District 117 on January 11, 2023, and advanced from the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.
